name: Saving Souls
overview: Scripture reveals that saving souls is an act of wisdom and righteousness, described as bearing fruit like a tree of life (Proverbs 11:30). Salvation is found exclusively through faith in Jesus Christ, who declared Himself the only way to the Father (John 14:6), and promises eternal life to those who believe (John 3:15-16). The call to salvation is urgent, for belief leads to being saved, while unbelief results in condemnation (Mark 16:16). Believers must wholeheartedly serve God alone, as divided allegiance is impossible (Matthew 6:24).
